text.KredimGeldi gizlilik bildirimi: web site: KredimGeldi Privacy Notice: how the information collected on the website is used, shared and protected.
text.Web sitemizi ziyaret ettiğinizde ve hizm: We explain how the information obtained when you visit our website and use our services is used and protected.
text.Kişisel Verilerinizin Toplanmasının Yasa: Legal Basis for the Collection of Your Personal Data
text.Kişisel Verilerin Kullanım Amaçları: Purposes of Use of Personal Data
text.KredimGeldi, gizlilik ve veri korumaya ö: KredimGeldi is a corporate company that attaches importance to privacy and data protection and operates under the umbrella of NEXORA LABS. This notice explains how visitor information collected through the website is collected, processed and protected.
text.Web sitemizi kullanırken kişisel veri pa: You are not required to share personal data when using our website. Only the information that you share voluntarily and knowingly is collected. This data may include information such as name, title, company address, email and telephone number. Your personal data is processed within the scope of KVKK (Turkish Personal Data Protection Law, No. 6698) on the grounds provided for by law, for the performance of a contract, for the fulfillment of legal obligations, on the basis of information made public, or in line with our legitimate interests.
text.IP adresi, tarayıcı tipi ve dili, erişim: Standard log information such as IP address, browser type and language, and access times is collected. Cookies and web beacons are used for the effective management and ease of use of our website. Details on the use and control of cookies can be found on our Cookie Policy page.
text.Kişisel verileriniz, özel içeriklere eri: Your personal data is processed for the purposes of fulfilling your requests, such as access to special content and participation in campaigns and surveys, conducting market research, maintaining customer communication and improving our services.
text.Kişisel verileriniz, hizmetlerimizin sun: Your personal data may be shared with our business partners and service providers for the provision of our services. It may also be shared with authorized institutions within the scope of legal obligations and statutory regulations.
text.Kişisel verileriniz, KVKK ve ilgili mevz: Your personal data may be transferred to our business partners abroad, in accordance with KVKK and the relevant legislation, on the basis of legitimate interests or contractual necessities.
text.Kişisel verilerinizin korunması için ger: The necessary administrative, technical and physical measures are taken to protect your personal data. The utmost care is exercised against data loss, unauthorized access and unlawful processing.
text.KVKK’nın 11. maddesi uyarınca, kişisel v: Pursuant to Article 11 of KVKK, you have rights regarding your personal data, such as the right to learn whether it is processed, to learn the purpose and scope of processing, to learn whether the data has been transferred, to request the rectification of incorrectly processed data, and to request the erasure or anonymization of the data.
text.Web sitemiz 18 yaş altı çocuklara yöneli: Our website is not directed at children under the age of 18, and no personal data is knowingly collected from this age group. If it is determined that data belonging to children under the age of 18 has been collected inadvertently, it will be deleted immediately.
